name: Eda Schunk Thompson
occupation: Sheridan County clerk and recorder (re-elected November 2026). The official clerk page states she has served since April 8, 2010, and is clerk to the Board of County Commissioners, county budget officer, and chief elections officer.
prior_offices: Sheridan County clerk and recorder (the official clerk page lists service from April 8, 2010, to the present; she was re-elected in 2026)
background: Eda Schunk Thompson is the Sheridan County clerk and recorder and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official clerk and recorder page lists her in that office and states that she has served Sheridan County since April 8, 2010, and that the clerk is clerk to the Board of County Commissioners, county budget officer, and chief elections officer.
